_README: Copy this file to runner.config.json and fill it in (see README.md). Generate each signing secret and API secret with `openssl rand -hex 32`. runner.config.json holds real secrets — chmod 600 it and NEVER commit it. server.mjs loads it from $RUNNER_CONFIG (the systemd unit sets /etc/chapter-craft-runner/runner.config.json) or ./runner.config.json.
_doc_keys: REQUIRED. Map of keyId -> signing secret. The app signs each request with HMAC-SHA256; the keyId it sends must exist here and the secret must match. Unknown or empty keys are rejected (no empty-secret fallback). You paste one keyId + its secret into the app's Program Foundry settings.
_doc_secrets: OPTIONAL. Map of SECRET_NAME -> value. A program declares which names it needs (manifest.secrets); the runner injects only those, by name, as env vars into that job's container, then REDACTS the values out of stdout/stderr. The app and the model never see these values — only the names.
_doc_sandbox_image: OPTIONAL (default chapter-craft-sandbox:latest). The docker image built from Dockerfile.sandbox.
_doc_egress_network: OPTIONAL (default ccprog-egress). The docker network created by setup-egress.sh for allowlist-egress jobs. Ignored entirely unless a program requests network 'allowlist' AND the startup self-test passed.
_doc_egress_proxy_ip: OPTIONAL (default 172.31.99.2). The ccprog-proxy container's fixed IP — must match setup-egress.sh's CCPROG_PROXY_IP. Injected into sandboxes as a static /etc/hosts entry for 'ccprog-proxy' because Docker's embedded DNS does not work under gVisor.
_doc_allowed_hosts_global: OPTIONAL (default []). The hostnames the egress proxy will dial for allowlist jobs. Empty array = deny all outbound (every job effectively runs offline even in allowlist mode). '*.example.com' matches the apex and any subdomain.
_doc_max_timeout_ms: OPTIONAL (default 60000). Hard ceiling on a job's wall-clock time; a program's own manifest.timeout_ms is clamped to this.
_doc_max_memory: OPTIONAL (default = `memory`). CEILING for a program's requested memory (manifest.memory). Raise it for heavier jobs, e.g. "2g". 0/"unlimited" is IGNORED and falls back to the default — never infinite. Swap is always pinned equal (no swap). Keep concurrency x max_memory <= (1 - reserve_ram_frac) x RAM.
_doc_max_cpus: OPTIONAL (default = `cpus`). CEILING for a program's requested CPU (manifest.cpus), e.g. "2". The sandbox always runs at --cpu-shares 512 (below host services) so jobs yield under contention. Keep concurrency x max_cpus <= cores - reserve_cores.
_doc_max_pids: OPTIONAL (default = `pids_limit`). CEILING for a program's process/thread count. Counts THREADS; the runner floors the effective value at 128 so the gVisor sentry can boot.
_doc_max_output_kb: OPTIONAL (default 128). Max KB of stdout+stderr returned per run before truncation.
_doc_reserve_cores: OPTIONAL (default 1). CPU cores held back for docker/the runner/your other services (e.g. Hermes bots). The boot safety governor clamps effective concurrency so raised ceilings never overcommit the box; it only ever LOWERS concurrency and logs when it does.
_doc_reserve_ram_frac: OPTIONAL (default 0.15, min 0.15). Fraction of RAM held back for the host. Combined with reserve_cores to compute the safe effective concurrency at boot.
_doc_persist_enabled: OPTIONAL (default false). MASTER SWITCH for persistent program state. While false, a program that requests persistence still runs but gets an EPHEMERAL /state (nothing survives). Set true only after creating state_dir (see docs). A persist program can write a secret to its /state that survives the run — the runner redacts the full secrets map from persist output, but treat persisted data as readable by anyone with host access.
_doc_state_dir: OPTIONAL (default /var/lib/chapter-craft-runner/state). Daemon-visible dir (NOT under /tmp) holding one 0777 sub-directory per (program-lineage, epoch); the 0700 parent gates host access. Must be owned by the runner user.
_doc_state_quota_mb: OPTIONAL (default 256). Soft per-program cap: a run is refused once that program's stored state exceeds this.
_doc_state_max_total_mb: OPTIONAL (default 4096). SOFT aggregate cap across ALL programs' state, checked BEFORE each run. /state is a bind mount with no hard size limit, so a single runaway run can still exceed this mid-run — keep it comfortably under free disk. Reduces, does not eliminate, the risk of program state filling the box.
_doc_concurrency: OPTIONAL (default 3). Max jobs running at once (clamped down at boot by reserve_cores/reserve_ram_frac if the box is too small for that many at the configured ceilings).
_doc_queue_max: OPTIONAL (default 10). Max jobs waiting for a slot before new requests get 429.
_doc_port: OPTIONAL (default 8752). server.mjs binds 127.0.0.1 on this port only; put Caddy/TLS in front (see README).
_doc_memory: OPTIONAL (default 512m). Per-container memory limit; swap is pinned equal so there is no swap.
